phase_name: Zotero Create-Item + Storage Re-Point + Delegate to literature-ingest.sh

objectives.description: Resolve storage/<attachmentKey>/<filename> defensively across plausible field paths
Fallback to staging path with flagged warning if storage path unreadable
Capture ingested doc_id from literature-ingest.sh output

approaches_tried.reason: literature-ingest.sh's log_out() prefixes stdout with '[ingest] ', so the bare-anchor regex never matched; silently fell back to the wrong doc_id and made the Phase 5 metadata patch a no-op. Fixed to match '^\[ingest\] Ingested: ' with a '^Documents ingested: ' fallback.

verification_notes: Full end-to-end test with a stub zot (real zot unavailable) and a hand-built valid minimal PDF: item-add creates a synthetic envelope, storage re-point resolves to the stub's simulated storage/ATTKEY01/source.pdf, literature-ingest.sh (real, unmodified) converts/chunks/indexes it successfully via PyMuPDF+pdftotext, and reports doc_id=source. git diff --stat confirms literature-ingest.sh/convert.sh/chunk.sh/build-index.sh remain byte-for-byte unmodified.
